scope: independent immutable local holding mirrors and read-only ledger diagnostics
preservedExisting: AccountAnalysis and BusinessStore ledger positions, weighted costs, realized/unrealized/fees, explicit cash, historical reports and account schemas are frozen
inputs: local CSV/TSV with known old holding headers
source: exact original UTF-8 text, actual-byte SHA256, all unknown file/snapshot/holding fields retained; no SQLite production-file reads, broker/credential/UI extraction, network or uploads
identity: explicit stock/ETF SH/SZ/BJ full ID selected from root read-only roster; no market/type/name inference from bare code. Source full ID/market/type/code hints cannot be contradicted; renamed-source mismatch requires recorded reason
accounts: exact current native ledger account; source native ID/account key/legacy ID hints all checked, ambiguity rejects; unknown source account requires explicit manual reason and target-account acknowledgment; no paper-account binding
missingness: optional quantity/cost/price/cash null remains unknown; numeric0 remains known0. Invalid/negative/fractional share counts and duplicate identities reject. Cost may be derived only from explicitly supplied average cost and quantity, basis recorded; contradictory total/average costs reject
completeness: source holdingsComplete=true enables explicit absent=0 diagnostic; partial/unknown absent stays unknown. Empty list requires explicit source true. Legacy list completeness can be manually acknowledged with evidence reason, recorded as not broker verified; explicit source false cannot be overridden
time: source/asOf preserved; malformed dates and timezone-free timestamps reject. Date alignment does not establish same instant. Quantity/cost deltas are cross-time diagnostics; cash difference only for matching explicit timestamp instants; unknown dynamic cash/performance attribution stay null

provider.ledger: explicit accountId/positions/positionsComplete/asOf/basis/cashBalance/cashAsOf/sourceLabel, provided by existing root ledger functions only

storage.policy: existing database application ID verified read-only before write open; immutable typed-canonical content fingerprints; atomic all-or-nothing insert and whole catalog CAS; same-ID content conflict rejects; comparison references validated
storage.largeRead: 24000 Unicode-codepoint SQL substr chunks avoid Android CursorWindow full-row limits

state: complete pending source, account/identity/completeness draft and reader mode/offset in bounded CAS owned sidecar; Android Bundle only file marker+fingerprint; corrupt or stale state rejects rather than auto-clearing/rebinding
actions: preview differences, explicit independent version save, fresh read-only comparison, explicit comparison evidence save, history/full original/full evidence export, exact current full-instrument chart callback; zero BusinessStore mutations
claims: integrity and explicit local bindings only, not verified broker balances, official reconciliation, account adjustment, independent accuracy or financial recommendation
acceptance: dedicated Qt/Java full cross/old-source parser tests; root hosted UI/device checks separate; no ARM-device claim
